name: Autodromo Nazionale Monza
notes: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Grand Prix circuit (clockwise). Via route over OSM circuit relation 284565. Its ways are tagged access=no, so the raceway loop search skips them. Pit lane excluded. Traced 5745 m vs 5793 m. Start line on the Rettifilo. Two DRS zones as in 2012: the straight from Lesmo 2 to Ascari and the pit straight. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
